refuter_findings.location: Statement, “constant-coefficient tangent system” and final “exact linear tangent model” sentence.
refuter_findings.evidence: The Statement calls the displayed PDE a “tangent system” and an “exact linear tangent model,” but identifies no nonlinear base system, equilibrium, or perturbation map. The proof establishes only the displayed standalone linear PDE, so it does not establish the tangent-model interpretation.

The Example asserts that the “flux per unit transverse width is Gh^3/(12η),” while Verification step 3.1 computes an integral without defining the asserted observable in the Example as the volume-flux integral over 0≤y≤h.

The Example claims uniqueness in “the unidirectional shear class” but does not define that class's velocity maps, regularity, or competing pressure class. Verification step 2.1 also leaves “another unidirectional shear” unspecified, so the uniqueness quantifier is not defined by the formulation.

The Example asserts a “flux per unit transverse width” of Vh/2, but does not define this observable there. Verification step 2.1 computes an integral without identifying it in the formulation as the volume-flux integral over 0≤y≤h.
The Example allows V∈ℝ and gives vorticity ω=(0,0,−V/h). Taking V=0 makes ω=0, contradicting the title “Couette shear has nonzero vorticity.”

reader_findings.location: ## Statement, “constant-coefficient tangent system” and final “exact linear tangent model” sentence.
